There have been many times when I had to make sacrifices between my personal life and work. No matter what happens, I will continue striving to achieve what I truly want.

hero.tag: A Lone Blue Fox Gazing at the World
hero.title: About Me
hero.description: Hello everyone, my name is Van Trung Thanh, and I am a student at Ho Chi Minh City Open University. I major in Information Technology with a professional focus on software development. I am also inspired by the training and development of AI models. Although I can become exhausted by work, I always remain persistent and do my best to complete my responsibilities well.

cv.overview_page_1: Page 1 summarizes my planned career goals before graduation, academic achievements at Ho Chi Minh City Open University, certification of participation in scientific research on AI, and foundational coursework.
cv.overview_page_2: Page 2 presents three experiences and completed projects, the skills I have acquired and practiced, my interests, and the activities I pursue in my free time.

header.title: Top Projects Pinned on GitHub
header.subtitle: A system for collecting and analyzing IT job postings in Vietnam (AIJMC), a tool for evaluating the trustworthiness of job postings (AIJMC-JPRA), a medical appointment management system (MBMS), an AI-generated text detector (AI-Indicator), an educational resource management system (ERM), and a sports venue booking application.

aijmc.title: AI IT Job Market Consultant (AIJMC)
aijmc.summary: A platform for IT job market analysis and career consulting based on a ReAct AI Agent and Hybrid RAG.
aijmc.description: The system collects and analyzes recruitment data from ITViec, TopDev, and VietnamWorks using Celery and Crawlee. It applies Hybrid Retrieval with a pgvector database to enhance semantic search. The Gemini 3.8 Flash model operates within the ReAct framework to provide personalized career roadmaps.

aijmc_jpra.title: AIJMC-JPRA: Job Posting Trustworthiness Assessment
aijmc_jpra.summary: An IEEE conference-standard research project for detecting fraudulent job postings and verifying their authenticity.
aijmc_jpra.description: A binary classification model evaluates the trustworthiness of a job posting through its URL. It integrates a PydanticAI Agent with real-time web retrieval through Playwright to cross-check evidence, calculate a confidence score, and produce detailed reasoning.

mbms.title: Medical Booking Management System (MBMS)
mbms.summary: An online medical appointment booking and management platform for clinics, developed as both a PWA and a native application.
mbms.description: A solution that digitizes medical appointment booking workflows at healthcare facilities. It optimizes the experience of patients and doctors through AI-Driven Development (AIDD) and Scrum, with complete containerized deployment through Docker.

ai_writing_indicator.title: AI-Generated Text Detector
ai_writing_indicator.category: Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
ai_writing_indicator.summary: A binary machine-learning classification model that detects whether Vietnamese journalistic text was generated by artificial intelligence or written by a person.
ai_writing_indicator.description: A specialized Vietnamese NLP pipeline is researched and trained to accurately distinguish news articles written by people from content synthesized by large language models (LLMs), supporting originality verification in digital publishing.

elearning_lcms.title: Educational Resource Management System (ERM)
elearning_lcms.summary: A comprehensive ERM system for managing, storing, and reusing digital learning resources, built with Django REST Framework and React Native.
elearning_lcms.description: The backend architecture processes digital learning content using a MySQL database, OAuth2 token-based access control, an administrative analytics dashboard, and Google GenAI integration for personalized learning-resource recommendations.

sports_field_booking.title: Sports Venue Booking and Management Application
sports_field_booking.summary: A system that allows users and administrators to book and manage football, badminton, and tennis venues within specified time slots.
sports_field_booking.description: A web application built with Flask and MySQL for real-time sports venue searches and reservations. It applies a rigorous quality-assurance process covering unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing with Selenium 3.
